title: SpikeQ: Spike-Guided Post-Training Quantization for Spiking Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.23046v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On neuromorphic chips, spiking neural networks (SNNs) consume far less energy than artificial neural networks (ANNs), but the limited memory of these chips requires low-bit synaptic weights and membrane potentials. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods provide them without retraining and, like those for ANNs, minimize numerical errors such as the mean squared error (MSE). In an SNN, however, a quantization error reaches later layers only through the spikes it flips. We find that errors of equal MSE can cause very different accuracy losses, whereas errors that flip the same fraction of spikes cause the same loss. We therefore propose SpikeQ, a spike-guided PTQ framework. For weights, we select the level of each weight by simulating the downstream neurons and minimizing their spike errors. For membrane potentials, most existing methods quantize the state after the reset, whereas neuromorphic chips compare the threshold with t

translated_title: SpikeQ：脉冲引导的脉冲神经网络训练后量化
translated_abstract: 在神经形态芯片上，脉冲神经网络（SNN）比人工神经网络（ANN）消耗的能量要少得多，但这些芯片有限的内存要求使用低比特的突触权重和膜电位。现有的训练后量化（PTQ）方法无需重新训练即可实现量化，并且与针对ANN的方法类似，它们通过最小化均方误差（MSE）等数值误差来工作。然而，在SNN中，量化误差只有通过其翻转的脉冲才能传播到后续层。我们发现MSE相同的误差可能造成截然不同的精度损失，而翻转相同比例脉冲的误差则会造成相同的精度损失。因此，我们提出了SpikeQ，一个脉冲引导的PTQ框架。对于权重，我们通过模拟下游神经元并最小化其脉冲误差来选择每个权重的量化级别。对于膜电位，大多数现有方法在复位后对状态进行量化，而神经形态芯片则将阈值与……（原文摘要不完整）
tldr: 该论文发现SNN中量化误差的精度损失取决于其翻转的脉冲比例而非MSE大小，据此提出SpikeQ框架，通过最小化下游神经元的脉冲误差来引导权重和膜电位的训练后量化。
en_tdlr: SpikeQ is a spike-guided post-training quantization framework for SNNs that minimizes spike errors of downstream neurons—rather than numerical errors like MSE—to achieve accurate low-bit quantization of synaptic weights and membrane potentials.
